account:
Today I have been keeping my mayoral appointments and asking about town business. What stands out is that both the builder and my dockside neighbour have independently urged me to attend the great hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred. The builder calls it a routine inspection of newly installed hall lanterns and their coverage. The neighbour initially called it a routine meeting and offered to walk there with me, then confirmed it was the same occasion the builder arranged, not a separate meeting. The neighbour deferred questions about attendance and details to the builder. Their shared interest in getting me there at precisely the same time makes me suspect there may be a coordinated gathering beyond a simple lighting inspection, perhaps a surprise celebration. That is only a guess: I have not seen preparations or heard anyone admit such a purpose.

Lighting has also come up at the bakery: the neighbour says the baker has put up cheerful lights simply to brighten it. I do not know whether that is connected to the hall lanterns. The builder was carrying a lantern when visiting town hall. Those details could all be ordinary improvements.

My tea appointment initially seemed oddly vague because the secretary could not identify the host from dockside inquiries. Visiting the cottage resolved that: the neighbour confirmed hosting me there daily at fifteen hundred, including tomorrow, and the secretary recorded the clarification. The secretary also recorded tomorrow's hall inspection after obtaining my approval. I have no evidence that the secretary knows of any hidden purpose. I am now back at the office and have asked about correspondence, accounts, petitions, and other news; I have not yet heard a reply.
